name: PixelForge Studios
description: Crafting virtual worlds, powering real-world victories.
story: PixelForge Studios, a leading French game developer known for immersive racing simulations, sees motorsport as the ultimate proving ground for precision and technology. They're eager to connect with a dedicated fanbase and showcase their brand to a global audience through high-performance partnerships. By supporting racing teams, PixelForge aims to bridge the gap between virtual and real racing, fostering innovation and inspiring gamers worldwide.
